verdict.rationale: The product is a set of agent skills operated conversationally. Its SKILL.md descriptions are written as natural-language triggers ("Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions 'red-green-refactor'"; "Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking"), and skills such as grilling and triage run as natural-language interviews. Slash commands are also offered, and a meta-skill helps users pick the right skill for their situation. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent evidence that the skills reliably auto-trigger from free-form requests (the runtime probe only verified installation), and documentation of how triggering behaves across the different supported agents.
